Plant It
Home

Welcome to Plant It

Your personal plant identification and care assistant. Upload a photo to identify a plant, get care instructions, and keep an eye on its soil moisture. No hardware needed: every plant gets a simulated sensor you can water; a real ESP8266 takes over when you connect one.

Identify a New Plant

Upload a photo of a plant to identify its species and get care recommendations.

View Your Plants

See all the plants you've identified and their care instructions.

care.light: Bright, indirect light. A metre or two from an east or west window is ideal; harsh midday sun scorches the leaves.

Care guide from the built-in plant library.
Watering

Water when the top 5 cm of soil is dry, roughly every 7-10 days; less in winter. Let excess water drain and never leave the pot standing in water.

Light

Temperature

18-27 C (65-80 F). Keep above 13 C (55 F) and away from cold draughts.

Humidity

Moderate to high (50-60 %). Mist occasionally or group with other plants.

Soil

Chunky, well-draining aroid mix: potting soil with orchid bark and perlite.

Fertilizer

Balanced liquid feed at half strength once a month from spring to early autumn; none in winter.

Soil moisture targets

Keep between 15% and 45% water content; water below 20%.

Zamioculcas zamiifolia

Family: Araceae

Care Instructions
General houseplant care (no species-specific guide is bundled; add your own OpenAI key under "Add Plant" for one).
Watering

Water when the top 2-3 cm of soil feels dry. Let the pot drain fully and never leave it standing in water.

Light

Bright, indirect light suits most houseplants; keep out of harsh midday sun.

Temperature

18-24 C (65-75 F). Avoid cold draughts and sudden swings.

Humidity

Moderate humidity (40-60 %). A pebble tray or grouping plants helps in dry rooms.

Soil

Well-draining potting mix with some perlite or bark for air.

Fertilizer

Balanced liquid feed at half strength every 2-4 weeks in spring and summer.

Soil moisture targets

Keep between 15% and 45% water content; water below 20%.

This step needs the physical watering device from the arduino/ folder, powered on and on the same network as the API. Identified Plant
Ficus lyrata

Common name: Fiddle leaf fig

Family: Moraceae

Confidence: 89%

Care Instructions
Care guide from the built-in plant library.
Watering

Water thoroughly when the top 5 cm of soil is dry, about every 7-10 days, then let it drain fully. Consistency matters more than quantity.

Light

Lots of bright, indirect light with a little gentle morning sun. Rotate a quarter turn each week so it grows straight.

Temperature

18-24 C (65-75 F); dislikes swings and cold draughts.

Humidity

Moderate (40-60 %). Wipe the large leaves monthly so they can breathe.

Soil

Well-draining indoor potting mix with added bark or perlite.

Fertilizer

High-nitrogen liquid feed (3-1-2) monthly in spring and summer.

Soil moisture targets

Keep between 15% and 45% water content; water below 20%.
